claim: The original retail Unity 5.6.5p3 extensionless globalgamemanagers includes ClassID19 Physics2DSettings PathID17 as one complete 208-byte original serialized object, absolute 0x4C5340..0x4C5410, SHA256 6e98836eadaeb994d979af1553accd38cdbe0e0a87d4099febf5a93982b36e04. Its first 8 bytes encode two little-endian float32 values [0, approximately -9.81], matching the Unity Physics 2D project gravity vector. The following 72 bytes are preserved exactly as raw source, including a u32 literal 32 at offset 76 without assigning field names not corroborated by the original Unity 5.6 schema. Its last 128 bytes contain exactly 32 consecutive original uint32 layer collision mask words, each 0xffffffff. This establishes authored 2D engine physics configuration only, not which physics engine or collision representation drives Fire Pro combat, arena motion or other runtime gameplay.
